exercises.analyzingHint: The outline, section titles, running headers and the shape of the questions are analysed.

exercises.partialText: Some pages have no text (scanned). Exercises on those pages are only found through the outline.

sensitivityHints.strict: Only sections with a clear exercise title or marked in the outline.
sensitivityHints.balanced: Also pages that are clearly lists of questions, even without a title.
sensitivityHints.broad: Also weak detections. Review before applying.

exercises.none: No exercises found with these filters

exercises.selectHint: Selects the pages in the Builder without changing anything.
exercises.removeHint: Keeps the book without these pages — handy to split theory from exercises.
